gloss: clear weather in May; fine day during the rainy season

definitions.gloss: clear weather in May; fine day during the rainy season
definitions.explanation: originally referred to brief clear spells during the rainy season (the fifth month in the lunar calendar), now commonly used for pleasant clear weather in May

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五月晴|さつきば}れだ。
examples.english: Today is a beautiful May day.

examples.japanese: {五月晴|さつきば}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下|もと}、⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The sports day was held under clear May skies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{五月晴|さつきば}れで、⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{乾|かわ}いた→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧。
examples.english: It was a rare clear May day, so the laundry dried well.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{五月|さつき} (fifth month/May in lunar calendar) + {晴|ば}れ (clear weather)

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally referred to clear spells during the rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧), which fell in the fifth month of the lunar calendar. The lunar fifth month corresponds roughly to June in the modern calendar.

MODERN USAGE:
Today, {五月晴|さつきば}れ is commonly used to describe pleasant, clear weather in May (modern calendar). Weather forecasters sometimes note this shift from the original meaning.

SEASONAL WORD ({季語|きご}):
{五月晴|さつきば}れ is a traditional seasonal word (kigo) for early summer in haiku.

RELATED SEASONAL EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{秋晴|あきば}れ→秋晴れ：08335_akibare⟧ - clear autumn weather
- ⟦{小春日和|こはるびより}→小春日和：08336_koharubiyori⟧ - Indian summer
- {梅雨晴|つゆば}れ - break in the rainy season
